prompt: How to count to 10 in Chinese?
response:
Counting to 10 in Chinese is quite simple. Here are the numbers:

1. 一 (yī) - one
2. 二 (èr) - two
3. 三 (sān) - three
4. 四 (sì) - four
5. 五 (wǔ) - five
6. 六 (liù) - six
7. 七 (qī) - seven
8. 八 (bā) - eight
9. 九 (jiǔ) - nine
10. 十 (shí) - ten

Each number has its own unique character and pronunciation. Practice saying them out loud to get a feel for how they sound!
